description: This file defines a specialized transaction processor for loan repayment schedules that enforces a specific payment order: principal first, then interest, penalties, and fees. It extends an abstract processor to handle on-time, late, and in-advance repayments, adjusting the order of component payments accordingly.

classes.name: PrincipalInterestPenaltyFeesOrderLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
classes.description: A transaction processor that enforces repayment order: principal -> interest -> penalties -> fees, extending the abstract processor for loan transactions.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the strategy code identifier for this repayment processor.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the human-readable name of this repayment strategy.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsPaymentInAdvanceOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles early payments by processing them as on-time payments, maintaining principal priority.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsALateRepaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles late payments similarly to on-time payments, prioritizing principal payments initially.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsOnTimePaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Processes on-time loan repayments with priority: interest first, then principal, fees, and penalties.

methods.name: handleRefundTransactionPaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Processes refunds, unapplying components in reverse order, starting from fees, penalties, interest, then principal.
